name: Pyramyth - Reborn
review:
Pyramyth - Reborn is a sci-fi Egyptian slot with 15 lines, wild payline multipliers, roaming wilds, sticky respins and a feature buy.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap and a 96.05% RTP.

Roaming wilds and sticky respins work together, and wild payline multipliers boost every line a wild touches. The neon sci-fi take on Egypt looks great on mobile.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
